summary: Iteration 14 — Features section illustration audit after scenes.jsx + kit3d.jsx fixes. Backend pytest 19/19 PASS (SEO, waitlist, careers, contact, admin JWT auth + jobs CRUD, dynamic careers listing). Frontend @1440 Features section (section-features): all three testids feature-visual-inputs / -summaries / -delivery render at 404x300px inside their 485px feature-card-1/2/3 columns. Card 1 Unified data hub shows the three colored-base source tiles with Google Ads / Meta / GA4 logos, blue hub (correctly differentiated from card 2's violet), dashed wires and the branded report doc with rows/pills. Card 2 AI-written summaries shows the violet glowing hub plus three staggered readable tags down the iso diagonal: 'Meta Ads · ROAS 2.4x', '+24% channel results', 'AI · drafting summary·' — no collisions / no overlap. Card 3 Quick response delivery shows the request→AI→branded doc chain with a visible mint base plate under the branded tile, the rewritten screen-space Dial (clean blue ring + rotating accent arc + '00:03' center text, no broken dotted-torus), and the enlarged 'Generating report… / 3 integrations live' billboard — NO green stain blob (Beam successfully removed). Only 1 shared <canvas> on Home @1440 (confirms shared renderer still works). Hover on feature-card-1 reacts (packet speed up / tile lift) without breaking layout — card bounds stable. Mobile @390x844: all three feature-visuals render at 348x300 stacked, 1 canvas, 0 horizontal overflow, tags remain legible after scene lazy-load (~3s). Regression: 0 canvas on /careers /pricing /blog. Admin login admin@example.com/admin123 at /admin/jobs works — 'SaaS Sales Intern LIVE' listing visible, Post job form present, Log out button present. No JS pageerrors. Minor console warnings only: deprecated THREE.Clock, 'Too many active WebGL contexts' (expected during initial multi-scene mount — resolves to 1 canvas), container position hint from framer-motion (pre-existing, not from this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: Dial rewrite as screen-space sprites (ring + rotating arc + depthTest=false text) renders crisply at the 300px scene scale — previous broken dotted-torus is gone and the '00:03' text is sharp.
Mint base plate under card 3's branded doc is subtle but visible; delivery hub color distinction (green/mint vs card 2 violet vs card 1 blue) now reads clearly across the three cards.
Card 2 tag restaggering (ROAS 2.25/-0.5, chip 1.57/0.3, AI drafting 0.92/1.1) removes the earlier collisions — all three tags readable simultaneously with no z-fighting.
WORLD tightening 10.6x5.6 → 9.6x5.2 effectively enlarges illustrations ~15% within the 300px cards without clipping the iso diagonal.
